notes.title: THE HOUSE OF THE DEAD: Remake - now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Traverse the grotesque mansion once more and behold the Curien's masterpiece!

• Well known arcade classic with modern graphics and controls, including gyro aiming
• True to the original gameplay
• Local 2-player multiplayer
• Multiple endings
• Photomode
• Achievements
• Armory with unlockable weapons
• Hordes of the undead monstrosities in a new game mode
• Gallery with encountered enemies and bosses

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1694600/THE_HOUSE_OF_THE_DEAD_Remake/

notes.title: Mr Blaster premiere on Steam
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Mr Blaster is now available on Steam!
New game inspired by classics like Worms - will bring the joy of shooting your opponent in the face to the whole new level! This fast-paced, casual game is set in the colorful cosmic environment with incredibly fun ragdoll physics and easy, well-known mechanics - with a twist!

Grab your rocket launchers and play with your friends!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/618490/ss_74f63742a6b9ea0fd4c25139af776e89494c35e4.600x338.jpg[/img]

Premiera Mr Blaster na Steam
Z radością informujemy, że Mr Blaster jest już dostępny na Steam!
Nowa gra inspirowana takimi klasykami jak Worms - przywróci radość ze strzelania w swojego przeciwnika prosto w twarz! Ta dynamiczna, casualowa gra przeniesie cię w kolorowy kosmos z niesamowicie zabawną fizyką ragdoll i prostą, dobrze znaną mechaniką rozgrywki - z małym twistem!

Chwyćcie za swoje wyrzutnie rakiet i zagrajcie z przyjaciółmi!

notes.title: Mr Blaster premiere date
notes.content:

Everyone who has won in a Mr Blaster's giveaway will receive game key via mail on 14 July (21:00 CEST)

----------------------------------------
